name_en: Kakiae namasu — vinegared edible chrysanthemum with lotus root and walnuts
summary_ja: 赤紫色の食用菊「かきのもと」をさっとゆで、れんこんやくるみと合わせて酢で和える新潟の郷土料理。精進料理として法事やお正月に欠かせず、秋の食卓に彩りを添えると伝わる。
summary_en: A Niigata dish of the reddish-purple edible chrysanthemum called kakinomoto, briefly blanched and dressed in vinegar with lotus root and walnuts. Rooted in shojin vegetarian cooking, it is said to be indispensable at memorial services and New Year, brightening the autumn table.
source_title: かきあえなます 新潟県｜うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
